plugins.description: Saan Kits: independently usable agent skills for product work. Includes Saan Diagram for business diagrams, Saan Mermaid for Mermaid diagrams and process reviews, Saan Discovery for consumer, enterprise, and public-sector research and product-fit assessment, Saan PRD Writing for requirements specifications and scoped changes, Saan Prototype for offline review prototypes from requirements specifications, Saan Inquiry for adaptive problem clarification and reflection, and Saan X-Ray for live system and codebase overview briefings and As-Is specifications.
